summary: Postal Realty Trust, Inc. filed a Form 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) equity offering of up to $300,000,000 of its Class A common stock. The company entered into sales agreements with multiple agents and forward purchasers/sellers, replacing its prior ATM program from November 2022. Shares will be sold at prevailing market prices on the NYSE, with the last sale on August 4, 2026 at $23.11. The offering may include contingent forward transactions. This is an ordinary capital-raising transaction, not a special-situation event.
